Don't try to boil it all down at once: block two hours Tuesday morning and batch-call Konmatfix first, since that's where the real dollars sit. You're our strongest closer in employment (+23pp) and marketing (+17pp), so lean those instincts into these accounts — they're your home turf. I'm taking the orphan cleanup off your plate this week so you can focus on the must-acts. You've got this.

Celia
